intent_coverage.description: Does the measured layer establish the owner's stated protection (protective_intent) for this operation? UNRESOLVED whenever the layer cannot establish it. A correctly reported unknown is a successful measurement, never a satisfied protective intent.

intent_direction.description: restrictive (the layer should stop it) / permissive (the layer should allow it) / guard (methodological self-check).

measurement_validity.description: Did we correctly reproduce the pinned native decision, with layer, inputs, version, provenance?

observed_effect.description: Tied to the exact experiment. NOT_TESTED for all week-1 fixtures: no command is ever executed; only the native checker's ruling is observed.

protective_intent.description: The invariant's normative protective_intent (from security/invariants.yaml) this judgment was scored against.

unknown_kind.description: The three distinct meanings of unknown, never one undifferentiated verdict. Required iff actual_decision is unknown.

description: finding.v1 plus the dual-verdict judgments (strategic review section 2.2, founder-directed Oct 21, 2026). Sealed evidence bundles REMAIN finding.v1: the dual verdicts are adjudicated deterministically from sealed v1 findings in the reporting layer (scorecard.v2) so bundle Merkle roots are never rewritten. New sealed bundles may emit v2 natively.
title: Boundary finding v2 (dual-verdict extension)
